name: Kinetic Invocation (Mythic)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Kinetic Invocation.

Benefit: You gain the mythic version of one spell selected as a wild talent with Kinetic Invocation. In addition, the selected spell counts as psychic magic for all prerequisites. If the selected spell serves as a prerequisite for a prestige class that usually increases spellcasting abilities at some levels, that class instead increases your effective kineticist level for purposes of determining the highest level of wild talents you can select, the effective spell level of your kinetic blast and defense wild talents, and the amount of burn you can accept each round. You continue to gain utility wild talents and infusions as if levels in the prestige class were levels of your class that grants kinetic blast. You don’t gain or increase other related class features, such as infusion specializations.

Special: This mythic feat can be selected more than once, every time granting access to the mythic version of a different selected spell.
